statements.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL company facts (public domain)
statements.methodology: Values as filed with the SEC (XBRL company facts, public domain), selected latest-filed per period; the winning us-gaap tag, accession number, and filing date are recorded per value in `provenance`. Quarters not filed discretely (Q4 generally; Q2-Q3 for cash-flow items, which 10-Qs tag year-to-date only) are derived solely by differencing two same-tag, same-fiscal-year facts and are marked derived with both source accessions; derivation is withheld when a surrounding filing restates prior periods. Per-share values are as filed and NOT adjusted for subsequent stock splits. Missing data is null — never zero-filled, never backfilled from any other source.
